topic: Vitrimer thermomechanical properties and network relaxation kinetics
root_query: vitrimer covalent adaptable network CAN stress relaxation activation energy Tg recycling dynamic bond exchange

scientific_papers.name: Montarnal D., Capelot M., Tournilhac F., Leibler L. — Silica-Like Malleable Materials from Permanent Organic Networks

extraction_strategy.target: Table S1 in Supplementary Materials and Section 3 for experimental formulation details

scientific_papers.notes: The pioneering vitrimer paper focusing on zinc-catalyzed transesterification of epoxy-acid networks. Contains pristine baseline and catalyst-dependent relaxation kinetics.

scientific_papers.name: Denissen W., Rivero G., Nicolaÿ R., Leibler L., Winne J.M., Du Prez F.E. — Vinylogous Urethane Vitrimers

extraction_strategy.target: Inline mechanical metrics and text block under Section 2 (Synthesis and Characterization)

scientific_papers.notes: Focuses on catalyst-free transamination of vinylogous urethanes. Contains tracking data for up to 4 consecutive grinding/compression molding recycling cycles.

scientific_papers.name: Tretbar C.A., Neal J.A., Guan Z. — Direct Silyl Ether Metathesis for Vitrimers with Exceptional Thermal Stability

extraction_strategy.target: Table 1 and SI Section 4 for PEOH silylated network performance data

scientific_papers.notes: Covers acid-catalyzed silyl ether metathesis chemistry. Critical for introducing high thermal stability limits into the predictive modeling domain.

scientific_papers.name: Wang S., Ma S., Li Q., Yuan W., Wang B., Zhu J. — Robust, Fire-Safe, Monomer-Recovery, Highly Malleable Thermosets from Renewable Bioresources

extraction_strategy.target: Table 1 for thermomechanical profiles of vanillin-derived Schiff base networks

scientific_papers.notes: Covers imine exchange chemistry within bio-based networks. Provides essential data points on chemical monomer recovery vs mechanical reprocessability.

scientific_papers.name: Li L., Chen X., Jin K., Torkelson J.M. — Vitrimers Designed Both To Strongly Suppress Creep and To Recover Original Cross-Link Density after Reprocessing

extraction_strategy.target: Inline data in Results section tracking stretched exponential parameters at 160 °C

scientific_papers.notes: Deals with transesterification in thiol-epoxy architectures using DMAP catalysts. Excellent data source for testing creep resistance limits in hybrid permanent/dynamic topologies.

databases.name: PoLyInfo — NIMS Polymer Database
databases.access_method: manual GUI export only — automated scraping prohibited by Terms of Service

extraction_strategy.target: Baseline control samples of static, non-reversible epoxy and polyurethane thermosets

databases.notes: Used strictly to obtain baseline Tg values for conventional un-catalyzed network structures to calculate delta-Tg shifting values caused by catalytic addition.

extraction_strategy.target: chemical component name → canonical SMILES identifier resolution

aggregators.notes: Fulfills automated web extraction pipeline tasks. Translates textual component listings parsed from PDFs (e.g., 'DGEBA', 'sebacic acid') into canonical SMILES strings.
